snippet.title: 🎬 My Music Label – How to Create a Tour 🎶 (Game Preview / WIP)
snippet.description:
🎬 My Music Label –How to Create a Tour 🎶 | Game Preview (WIP)

In this video, I’m showing how to create a **Tour** in my upcoming music management game!

🎟️ Set your ticket price and influence demand
🏟️ Pick the right venues for your audience
🎨 Take a look at the tour visuals & interface

⚠️ This is a preview only — the game is still in development!

👍 Like & subscribe if you want to follow the project
💬 Tell me what you think in the comments!

#GameDev #IndieGame #MusicGame #SimulationGame #Devlog #Trailer #WIP
